prompt: For each store_code, how many units does an order line hold on average? Work it out as the total units divided by the number of lines that have a units value, rounded to 2 decimals with ROUND(x, 2). Use the sales table. Return store_code and units_per_line, one row per store. Any row order is fine. Which query returns it?

options.text:
SELECT store_code,
       ROUND(SUM(units) * 1.0 / COUNT(units), 2) AS units_per_line
FROM sales
GROUP BY store_code

SELECT store_code,
       ROUND(SUM(units) // COUNT(units), 2) AS units_per_line
FROM sales
GROUP BY store_code

SELECT store_code,
       CAST(SUM(units) / COUNT(units) AS INTEGER) AS units_per_line
FROM sales
GROUP BY store_code

SELECT store_code,
       ROUND(SUM(units) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS units_per_line
FROM sales
GROUP BY store_code
